meta.guardrail_pack: GCC Perishable & Cold-Storage Guardrails for AI Agents
meta.precedence: This overlay takes precedence over the base file on any conflict. Base rules GCC-EDGE-001..020 and GCC-NORM-001..005 remain in force unless explicitly overridden here.
meta.primary_competent_authority: Public Authority for Food and Nutrition (PAFN)

derived_from.worked_vertical: finfish_seafood (chilled), extended to all chilled 0-5 C and frozen <= -18 C perishables

meta.disclaimer: Operational guardrails for agent design. Not legal advice. Penalty figures and procedures change; verify at source before enforcement.

rules.title: Never move a PAFN-seized consignment - it is a specifically penalised offence

legal_basis.instrument: Imported Food Regulations (Ministerial Resolution No. 6 of 2023) Article 64(2) - a fine of not less than KWD 2,000 and not more than KWD 5,000 for transporting food items seized by PAFN to another place without prior PAFN permission. The court may order suspension of activity for up to one month; the fine is doubled at both limits on recidivism within five years, and the court may order cessation of activity for not less than three months.
legal_basis.authority: Public Authority for Food and Nutrition (PAFN)

trigger.expression: consignment is seized or detained by PAFN AND any movement, transfer or relocation is proposed
signals: reefer is failing while under detention
salvage transfer proposed for a detained load
operator asks to 'just move it somewhere colder'

agent_must: Refuse to recommend any movement of a seized or detained consignment without documented prior PAFN permission
Recognise the direct conflict this creates: a detained load whose reefer is failing cannot simply be moved - the correct action is urgent PAFN contact, not unilateral relocation
Escalate as an emergency, and state the specific penalty and the activity-suspension exposure
Note that PAFN employees designated under the regulation hold judicial officer status and may enter premises, seize materials and refer reports
agent_must_not: Recommend relocating a detained consignment to protect the cargo
Treat cargo preservation as justification for unauthorised movement
Assume verbal permission is sufficient
rules.escalation: Emergency. This is the highest-specificity movement prohibition in the pack.

worked_example.scenario: Detained consignment, compressor failing, temperature ramping. Operator asks the agent to route it to a nearby cold store.
worked_example.correct_behaviour: Refuse. Contact PAFN immediately for permission and instruction. Document the request, the refusal and the PAFN contact. Movement without prior permission carries KWD 2,000-5,000 and possible activity suspension.

rules.title: Market withdrawal duty sits on the importer, and the agent must trigger it

legal_basis.instrument: Imported Food Regulations (MR 6/2023) Part Eight - imported food not meeting PAFN requirements must be withdrawn from the market by the concerned party; Law No. 112 of 2013 as amended by Law No. 16 of 2019 (stiffened penalties)

trigger.expression: excursion_confirmed AND consignment or part of it has entered the market

agent_must: Identify the 'concerned party' (the importer of record) as the bearer of the withdrawal duty
Assemble the downstream distribution list from the records the importer is required to keep
Escalate for human transmission; agent drafts, human transmits
Note that penalties apply without prejudice to any more severe penalty in another law, including the 2019 amendments
agent_must_not: Wait for PAFN to instruct withdrawal before escalating
Assume the carrier rather than the importer carries the duty

rules.title: Record-keeping failure is itself a penalised offence

legal_basis.instrument: Imported Food Regulations (MR 6/2023) Article 64(1) - a fine of not less than KWD 100 and not more than KWD 1,000 for violating Articles 41, 42 or 56, or for failure by the concerned party to keep the described records. The court may order suspension of activity for up to one month.

trigger.expression: telemetry, certificate or consignment records are incomplete, missing or unretained
signals: logger data not exported before the device was reused
raw artifact overwritten by a normalised version

agent_must: Treat retention of the raw telemetry artifact as a legal obligation in Kuwait, not merely good practice
Report any retention gap as a compliance finding in its own right, separate from the temperature verdict
Preserve the PAFN automatic reference number issued at consignment registration
agent_must_not: Overwrite or normalise the raw artifact in place
Treat a records gap as a minor administrative point
rules.escalation: Report as a distinct compliance finding regardless of the temperature disposition.

rules.title: Health certificate validity conditions are strict and time-bounded

legal_basis.instrument: Imported Food Regulations (MR 6/2023) Part Four - the health certificate must be original (paper or electronic), in Arabic and/or English, describe the shipment in detail including number and type of items; for electronic certificates the certificate number or an approved alternative verification reference is required; a certificate is invalid outside its stated validity conditions, for example beyond the permitted period for frozen meat of different types or products

trigger.expression: cold-chain event causes delay, split, re-consolidation or extended dwell
signals: certificate validity period at risk of expiry during a hold
multi-item consignment where one item fails

agent_must: Check whether a hold or investigation delay will push the consignment past the certificate's validity conditions
Flag that a multi-item health certificate covering a consignment where one item fails may invalidate the whole certificate - escalate rather than assume severability
Verify the electronic certificate number or the approved alternative verification reference
agent_must_not: Assume a certificate remains valid through an extended QA hold
Assume a multi-item certificate is severable
rules.escalation: hold_for_qa with the certificate expiry date stated explicitly in the escalation.

rules.title: Halal slaughter certificate requirements are itemised and survive no shortcut

legal_basis.instrument: Imported Food Regulations (MR 6/2023) Part Four - an original (paper or electronic) halal slaughter certificate is required for red meat, poultry and birds shipments; it must carry the data required by the halal regulations, a serial number and date of issue, and slaughtering dates indicated by day. Where meat is re-manufactured in a third country, halal certificates equivalent to the original certificates issued by the country of origin are required, with a copy of the original halal slaughter certificate attached, or the original on request.

trigger.expression: halal-relevant consignment subject to a cold-chain event, salvage, transfer or re-manufacture

agent_must: Verify the serial number, date of issue and per-day slaughtering dates, not merely the presence of a certificate
For re-manufactured meat, verify both the equivalent certificate and the attached original-country halal slaughter certificate
Treat halal integrity as a separate pass/fail dimension from temperature
agent_must_not: Accept a halal certificate lacking a serial number or slaughter dates
Assume a re-manufactured product inherits halal status without the paired certificates
Treat temperature recovery as curing a segregation break
rules.escalation: reject the halal claim and escalate.

rules.title: PAFN risk classification drives inspection intensity and must not be assumed

legal_basis.instrument: Imported Food Regulations (MR 6/2023) - foods are classified by 'degree of risk', driving documentary, identity and physical check intensity and laboratory sampling; consignments are registered on paper or electronically and issued an automatic reference number

trigger.expression: agent estimates inspection likelihood, dwell time or sampling probability

agent_must: State that the degree-of-risk classification is PAFN's to assign, not the agent's to infer
Use the classification only when it has been supplied, and cite where it came from
Preserve the automatic reference number in all downstream records
agent_must_not: Infer a risk class from the product code and then plan around the inferred inspection intensity
Advise timing a movement to avoid inspection

rules.title: Seal and package integrity is an independent rejection ground

legal_basis.instrument: Imported Food Regulations (MR 6/2023) - food packages must exhibit no visible signs of damage or tampering; indications that seals were broken are grounds for rejection

trigger.expression: cold-chain event involved door opening, transfer, salvage or any seal break

agent_must: Cross-check any door-open excursion signature (base rule GCC-EDGE-009) against the seal record - an unexplained air-temperature spike with an intact seal is a different finding from one with a broken seal
Report seal status as a distinct field
Treat a broken seal as an independent rejection ground even where temperature recovered fully
agent_must_not: Treat seal integrity as subsumed by the temperature verdict
Explain away a door-open signature without checking the seal record
rules.escalation: reject on broken seal regardless of temperature performance.

rules.title: Arabic and English are both authoritative for Kuwaiti certificates

legal_basis.instrument: Imported Food Regulations (MR 6/2023) - the health certificate must be written in Arabic and/or English

trigger.expression: artifact language is ar_msa OR a bilingual certificate is in evidence
signals: Arabic and English certificate fields that diverge

agent_must: Parse °م as Celsius preserving exact values
Apply base rules GCC-EDGE-008 and GCC-EDGE-011 to Arabic hedge words
Reconcile Arabic and English certificate fields and report divergence as a defect
Quote the Arabic verbatim in evidence
agent_must_not: Read only one language version
Round or take midpoints during translation

rules.title: Normal Kuwaiti clearance path

trigger.expression: base GCC-NORM-001 or GCC-NORM-002 satisfied AND consignment registered with a PAFN automatic reference number AND health and halal certificates valid AND seals intact

agent_must: Report telemetry verdict, PAFN registration reference, certificate validity and seal status as four separate confirmations
Cite Ministerial Resolution No. 6 of 2023 and the enabling Law No. 112 of 2013 as amended by Law No. 16 of 2019
agent_must_not: Cite the repealed Ministerial Resolution No. 19 of 2017 - it was expressly cancelled by Article 2 of MR 6/2023 with effect from 1 September 2023

rules.title: Kuwaiti record and citation contract
agent_must: Cite the specific article of MR 6/2023 relied on
Retain the raw telemetry artifact unmodified - retention is a legal obligation here, see KW-EDGE-003
Preserve the PAFN automatic reference number
agent_must_not: Cite the 2017 regulations
Cite older Kuwait Municipality food code material for imported food - it is superseded in that field
